title: 计算机科学，从零搭建 · 第53部分：量子计算

chapters.Bqp: 11. 量子计算机做不到的事
chapters.Outro: 回顾、习题，以及它们会在哪里再出现

49dbec42c4c9.en: In 1981 Richard Feynman gave a talk with a simple question: can a computer simulate physics? <bookmark mark='a'/> For classical physics, yes. But a system of quantum particles is described by one complex number, an amplitude, for every combination of their states. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ten two-state particles need about a thousand amplitudes, which fit in sixteen kilobytes. Twenty need sixteen megabytes. Thirty, sixteen gigabytes; forty, sixteen terabytes; fifty, sixteen petabytes. <bookmark mark='c'/> Three hundred particles need more numbers than there are atoms in the observable universe. Feynman suspected no classical computer could keep up, and proposed the alternative: build the computer out of quantum parts, and let nature do the arithmetic.
49dbec42c4c9.zh: 1981年，Richard Feynman 做了一次演讲，提出一个简单的问题：计算机能模拟物理吗？<bookmark mark='a'/>对经典物理，可以。但一个由量子粒子组成的系统，要用一个复数来描述它们状态的每一种组合，这个复数叫作振幅。<bookmark mark='b'/>10个两态粒子大约需要1000个振幅，放得进16千字节。20个需要16兆字节。30个，16吉字节；40个，16太字节；50个，16拍字节。<bookmark mark='c'/>300个粒子需要的数，比可观测宇宙中的原子还多。Feynman 怀疑没有任何经典计算机能跟得上，于是提出了另一条路：用量子部件来造计算机，让自然去做算术。

3fdfcdc5669d.en: Part 1 met the extended Church–Turing thesis: any reasonable computer can be simulated by a probabilistic Turing machine with at most polynomial slowdown. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1985 David Deutsch described a universal quantum computer. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 1994 Peter Shor showed that such a machine could factor large numbers in polynomial time, which would break the cryptography of Part 30. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 1996 Lov Grover showed it could search an unsorted list in about the square root of its length, and no quantum algorithm can do better. <bookmark mark='d'/> And in 2024 an experiment showed quantum error correction getting better, not worse, as the code grows. <bookmark mark='e'/> If large machines can be built, the extended thesis is false. This part builds the mathematics, and a simulator, and runs every algorithm on it.
3fdfcdc5669d.zh: 第1部分遇到过扩展的丘奇–图灵论题：任何合理的计算机，都能被一台概率图灵机以至多多项式级的减速模拟。<bookmark mark='a'/>1985年，David Deutsch 描述了一台通用量子计算机。<bookmark mark='b'/>1994年，Peter Shor 证明这样的机器能在多项式时间内分解大数，这将攻破第30部分的密码学。<bookmark mark='c'/>1996年，Lov Grover 证明它能用大约列表长度的平方根那么多步，搜索一个无序列表，而且没有任何量子算法能做得更好。<bookmark mark='d'/>2024年，一项实验显示，随着码变大，量子纠错变得更好，而不是更差。<bookmark mark='e'/>如果能造出大型的机器，扩展的论题就是错的。这一部分搭建其中的数学，再搭一个模拟器，并在上面运行每一个算法。

5ddd15b7e75c.en: This is Part 53 of Computer Science, Built. <bookmark mark='a'/> We start with the energy cost of forgetting a bit, and computation that never forgets. Then the qubit, the Bloch sphere and entanglement; interference as the resource behind every quantum algorithm; the quantum Fourier transform, built from Part 19's butterflies; Shor's algorithm factoring fifteen and twenty-one on our own simulator; Grover's search; error correction; and an honest account of what quantum computers cannot do.
5ddd15b7e75c.zh: 这是计算机科学，从零搭建，第53部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们从遗忘一位的能量代价开始，以及从不遗忘的计算。然后是量子比特、Bloch 球和纠缠；干涉，每一个量子算法背后的资源；量子傅里叶变换，用第19部分的蝶形搭成；Shor 算法，在我们自己的模拟器上分解15和21；Grover 搜索；纠错；以及一份诚实的说明：量子计算机做不到什么。

78ed143bc00e.en: Chapter one. The cost of forgetting. Does computing have to cost energy?
78ed143bc00e.zh: 第一章：遗忘的代价。计算一定要耗费能量吗？

833a48592af1.en: Most of the logic we built in Part 3 throws information away. <bookmark mark='a'/> An AND gate takes four possible inputs to two possible outputs. Three different inputs all give a zero, and once you see the zero you cannot say which of them it was. <bookmark mark='b'/> Is that forgetting free? Picture the simplest memory there is: one molecule in a box, with a wall in the middle. Left means zero, right means one. <bookmark mark='c'/> To erase the bit, setting it to zero whatever it held, pull out the wall, push a piston to the middle, and put the wall back. <bookmark mark='d'/> Two possible states have become one. The physics says that lost uncertainty cannot vanish: it ends up in the surroundings, as heat.
833a48592af1.zh: 我们在第3部分搭建的逻辑，大多会把信息扔掉。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个与门把四种可能的输入映到两种可能的输出。三种不同的输入都给出零，一旦看到这个零，你就说不出它是其中哪一种。<bookmark mark='b'/>这种遗忘是免费的吗？想象一下最简单的存储器：盒子里的一个分子，中间有一堵墙。在左边表示零，在右边表示一。<bookmark mark='c'/>要擦除这一位，也就是不管它原来存的是什么都把它置为零，就抽出墙，把一个活塞推到中间，再把墙放回去。<bookmark mark='d'/>两种可能的状态变成了一种。物理学告诉我们，失去的不确定性不会凭空消失：它最终以热的形式进入周围环境。

34c6a0f3f75a.en: In 1961 Rolf Landauer, at IBM, put a number on it. <bookmark mark='a'/> Erasing a bit whose value is unknown takes the memory from two possible states to one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its entropy falls by Boltzmann's constant times the logarithm of two. <bookmark mark='c'/> The second law of thermodynamics says the total cannot fall, so at least that much entropy must reach the surroundings, carried by heat: at least k T log two. <bookmark mark='d'/> At room temperature, three hundred kelvin, <bookmark mark='e'/> that is about three times ten to the minus twenty-one joules, or eighteen thousandths of an electronvolt, per bit. <bookmark mark='f'/> A billion billion erasures a second at this limit would cost about three milliwatts. Real transistors spend far more than this per switch. In 2012 a team in Lyon measured it, with a glass bead in a two-well laser trap.
34c6a0f3f75a.zh: 1961年，IBM 的罗尔夫·兰道尔给它定了一个数。<bookmark mark='a'/>擦除一个值未知的位，让存储器从两种可能的状态变成一种。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的熵减少了 Boltzmann 常数乘以2的对数。<bookmark mark='c'/>热力学第二定律说，总熵不能减少，所以至少有这么多的熵必须由热带到周围环境中：至少是 k T 乘以2的对数。<bookmark mark='d'/>在室温，也就是300开尔文下，<bookmark mark='e'/>每一位大约是3乘以10的负21次方焦耳，也就是千分之18电子伏特。<bookmark mark='f'/>在这个极限下每秒擦除10亿亿次，大约要耗费3毫瓦。真实的晶体管每次开关耗费的远远超过这个数。2012年，里昂的一个团队用双势阱激光阱里的一颗玻璃珠测量到了它。

f08ded07d851.en: The way out is to compute without merging states. <bookmark mark='a'/> Tommaso Toffoli's gate takes three bits and flips the third only if the first two are both one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its table moves only two of the eight rows, swapping them: it is a permutation, so no two inputs share an output, nothing is lost, and applying it twice gives back the input. <bookmark mark='c'/> Edward Fredkin's gate swaps the second and third bits when the first is one; it even conserves the number of ones, like billiard balls. <bookmark mark='d'/> Neither throws anything away, and yet, with the third input set to zero, Toffoli's gate writes a AND b. Given constant inputs, either gate can build any Boolean circuit at all. Logic does not need to forget.
f08ded07d851.zh: 出路是计算时不合并状态。<bookmark mark='a'/>托马索·托福利的门接受三位，只有在前两位都是一时才翻转第三位。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的表在八行中只动了两行，把它们交换：它是一个置换，所以没有两个输入共享同一个输出，什么都没丢，连用两次就回到输入。<bookmark mark='c'/>爱德华·弗雷德金的门在第一位为一时交换第二位和第三位；它甚至保持一的个数不变，就像台球一样。<bookmark mark='d'/>两者都不扔掉任何东西，然而，把第三个输入置为零，托福利门写出的就是 a 且 b。给定常数输入，这两种门中的任何一种都能搭出任意布尔电路。逻辑并不需要遗忘。

20002218d03b.en: Charles Bennett, also at IBM, showed in 1973 that any computation can be done reversibly. <bookmark mark='a'/> Give the circuit three registers: the input, a work area of zeros, and an output of zeros. <bookmark mark='b'/> First compute, reversibly: the work area now holds the answer, f of x, and a pile of intermediate garbage. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then copy the answer into the output, with controlled-NOTs, which is reversible too. <bookmark mark='d'/> Finally run the first circuit backwards. It turns the work area back into zeros, garbage and all. Nothing was ever erased, so no heat is owed. <bookmark mark='e'/> The price is about twice the steps, and space for the garbage in between. And this trick returns in every quantum algorithm in this part: garbage left behind would stay entangled with the answer and spoil the interference.
20002218d03b.zh: 同样在 IBM 的查尔斯·贝内特在1973年证明，任何计算都可以可逆地完成。<bookmark mark='a'/>给电路三个寄存器：输入，一块全为零的工作区，以及一个全为零的输出。<bookmark mark='b'/>先可逆地计算：工作区现在存着答案 f(x)，以及一堆中间垃圾。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后用受控非门把答案复制到输出里，这一步也是可逆的。<bookmark mark='d'/>最后把第一个电路倒着运行一遍。它把工作区连同垃圾一起变回零。从来没有擦除过任何东西，所以不欠任何热量。<bookmark mark='e'/>代价是大约两倍的步数，以及中途存放垃圾的空间。而这个技巧会在这一部分的每一个量子算法里再次出现：留下的垃圾会和答案保持纠缠，破坏干涉。

ab29e8fbf51f.en: Now write a reversible gate as a matrix acting on its basis states. <bookmark mark='a'/> Toffoli's gate becomes an eight by eight matrix with a single one in every row and column: a permutation. <bookmark mark='b'/> The NOT gate is the smallest. <bookmark mark='c'/> Permutation matrices are exactly the unitary matrices whose entries are zeros and ones. Allow any unitary, like this one, and the computation stays reversible but is no longer a shuffle of states: it is a rotation. <bookmark mark='d'/> That step was taken in three papers. In 1980 Paul Benioff described a Turing machine as a quantum-mechanical system. In 1982 Feynman proposed simulating physics with a computer made of quantum parts. And in 1985 David Deutsch defined the universal quantum computer. The next chapter meets its unit, the qubit.
ab29e8fbf51f.zh: 现在把一个可逆门写成作用在它的基态上的矩阵。<bookmark mark='a'/>托福利门变成一个8乘8的矩阵，每一行和每一列都恰好有一个1：一个置换。<bookmark mark='b'/>非门是最小的一个。<bookmark mark='c'/>置换矩阵恰好就是元素只有0和1的那些酉矩阵。允许任意的酉矩阵，比如这一个，计算依然是可逆的，但不再是对状态的洗牌：它是一次旋转。<bookmark mark='d'/>这一步是在三篇论文里迈出的。1980年，Paul Benioff 把图灵机描述为一个量子力学系统。1982年，Feynman 提出用量子部件做成的计算机来模拟物理。1985年，David Deutsch 定义了通用量子计算机。下一章认识它的单元：量子比特。

2deaa6b20fbf.en: Chapter two. The qubit. What does one quantum bit actually hold?
2deaa6b20fbf.zh: 第二章：量子比特。一个量子比特究竟存着什么？

4e4bda95f3e4.en: A qubit's state is a vector with two components, called amplitudes: alpha times the state zero, plus beta times the state one. <bookmark mark='a'/> Draw the two basis states as perpendicular axes, and the state as a unit arrow between them. <bookmark mark='b'/> When we measure, we see zero with probability alpha squared and one with probability beta squared. This is the Born rule, from 1926, and it is why the arrow has length one: the probabilities must add to one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Turn the arrow and the odds change smoothly. <bookmark mark='d'/> But an amplitude can also be negative, and in general complex. This arrow gives the same probabilities as the first, yet it is a different state. Probabilities can only add up; amplitudes can cancel, and quantum algorithms are built on that difference.
4e4bda95f3e4.zh: 一个量子比特的状态是一个有两个分量的向量，这两个分量叫作振幅：α 乘以状态零，加上 β 乘以状态一。<bookmark mark='a'/>把两个基态画成互相垂直的两根轴，把状态画成它们之间的一根单位箭头。<bookmark mark='b'/>测量时，我们以 α 平方的概率看到零，以 β 平方的概率看到一。这就是1926年的 Born 规则，也正是箭头长度为1的原因：概率之和必须是1。<bookmark mark='c'/>转动箭头，概率就平滑地变化。<bookmark mark='d'/>但振幅也可以是负的，一般来说是复数。这根箭头给出的概率和第一根一样，却是一个不同的状态。概率只能相加；振幅却能相互抵消，而量子算法正是建立在这个差别之上。

86e638c131b4.en: How many numbers does a qubit need? <bookmark mark='a'/> Alpha and beta are complex, so four real numbers, with one constraint: three are left. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiply the whole state by a phase and no measurement can tell the difference, so we may drop that overall phase. What remains physical is the relative phase between the two amplitudes, phi. <bookmark mark='c'/> And because the squared sizes add to one, they are the cosine and sine of one angle, which we call theta over two. <bookmark mark='d'/> Two angles: a point on a sphere. <bookmark mark='e'/> The relative phase is invisible to a measurement of zero against one. The plus state and the minus state both give fifty-fifty odds, differing only in one sign. Yet they are as different as two states can be: in the next chapter one gate turns the first into zero and the second into one.
86e638c131b4.zh: 一个量子比特需要多少个数？<bookmark mark='a'/>α 和 β 是复数，所以是四个实数，再加一个约束：剩下三个。<bookmark mark='b'/>把整个状态乘以一个相位，任何测量都分辨不出差别，所以我们可以去掉这个整体相位。剩下的、有物理意义的，是两个振幅之间的相对相位 φ。<bookmark mark='c'/>又因为两者大小的平方之和为1，它们就是同一个角的余弦和正弦，我们把这个角叫作 θ 除以2。<bookmark mark='d'/>两个角：球面上的一个点。<bookmark mark='e'/>在零对一的测量里，相对相位是看不见的。加态和减态都给出各一半的概率，只差一个符号。然而两者的差别已经大到两个状态所能达到的极限：在下一章里，一个门会把前者变成零，把后者变成一。

9803802a783f.en: Felix Bloch's sphere draws every state of one qubit as a point on a ball. <bookmark mark='a'/> Theta is the latitude: zero sits at the north pole and one at the south. <bookmark mark='b'/> Tip the arrow down to the equator and we reach the plus state, an equal superposition. <bookmark mark='c'/> Phi is the longitude, the relative phase. Going once round the equator passes the states plus i, minus, and minus i, all with fifty-fifty odds. <bookmark mark='d'/> Notice what the half angle did. Zero and one are perpendicular vectors, but on the sphere they are opposite poles; plus and minus are opposite too. Every pair of orthogonal states sits at the two ends of a diameter. <bookmark mark='e'/> For an electron's spin, the arrow is the axis along which a measurement is certain to find the spin pointing up.
9803802a783f.zh: Felix Bloch 的球面，把一个量子比特的每一个状态画成球上的一个点。<bookmark mark='a'/>θ 是纬度：零位于北极，一位于南极。<bookmark mark='b'/>把箭头向下倾到赤道，就到了加态，一个等权叠加。<bookmark mark='c'/>φ 是经度，也就是相对相位。沿赤道走一圈，会经过加 i 态、减态和减 i 态，它们的概率都是各一半。<bookmark mark='d'/>注意这个半角做了什么。零和一是互相垂直的向量，但在球面上它们是相对的两极；加态和减态也是相对的。每一对正交的状态，都位于一条直径的两端。<bookmark mark='e'/>对电子的自旋来说，这根箭头就是这样一根轴：沿着它测量，一定会发现自旋朝上。

3a0e3610ccba.en: What does a measurement see on the sphere? <bookmark mark='a'/> By the Born rule, the chance of a zero is the cosine squared of half of theta. <bookmark mark='b'/> The double-angle formula turns that into one plus cosine theta, over two. <bookmark mark='c'/> And cosine theta is just the arrow's height, z. The probability of zero is one plus the height, over two: certain at the north pole, impossible at the south, and even anywhere on the equator, whatever the phase. <bookmark mark='d'/> Measurement is not gentle. Afterwards the state is the answer we saw: the arrow has jumped to a pole, and the rest of the information is gone. <bookmark mark='e'/> To ask about a different axis, rotate it to the vertical first, and then measure.
3a0e3610ccba.zh: 测量在球面上看到的是什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>根据 Born 规则，得到零的概率是 θ 的一半的余弦的平方。<bookmark mark='b'/>倍角公式把它变成1加上余弦 θ，再除以2。<bookmark mark='c'/>而余弦 θ 恰好就是箭头的高度 z。得到零的概率等于1加高度，再除以2：在北极是必然的，在南极是不可能的，在赤道上任何地方都是一半对一半，不管相位如何。<bookmark mark='d'/>测量可不温和。测量之后，状态就是我们看到的那个答案：箭头已经跳到了一个极点，其余的信息都没了。<bookmark mark='e'/>要问另一根轴，就先把它转到竖直方向，再测量。

c50931d85193.en: So a qubit's state takes a continuum of values. <bookmark mark='a'/> Can we store a whole real number in it? <bookmark mark='b'/> No. A measurement returns one bit, and destroys the rest. Alexander Holevo proved in 1973 that n qubits sent on their own can carry at most n bits of classical information. <bookmark mark='c'/> The power of quantum computers is not storage. It comes from what happens to many qubits together, before anyone looks: their amplitudes multiply in number and interfere. <bookmark mark='d'/> Physically, a qubit is any well-controlled two-level system: two energy levels of a superconducting circuit, or of a trapped ion; atoms held by laser tweezers; or a photon's polarisation. The mathematics is the same for all of them.
c50931d85193.zh: 所以一个量子比特的状态取值于一个连续统。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们能在里面存下一个完整的实数吗？<bookmark mark='b'/>不能。一次测量只返回一位，并毁掉其余部分。Alexander Holevo 在1973年证明，单独发送的 n 个量子比特，至多能携带 n 位经典信息。<bookmark mark='c'/>量子计算机的威力不在于存储。它来自许多量子比特在任何人观看之前一起发生的事情：它们的振幅成倍增多，并且相互干涉。<bookmark mark='d'/>在物理上，量子比特就是任何一个控制良好的二能级系统：超导电路的两个能级，或者一个被囚禁离子的两个能级；被激光光镊抓住的原子；或者一个光子的偏振。对所有这些，数学都是一样的。

61f6b9083c00.en: Chapter three. Gates, tensor products and entanglement. What can two qubits do that two bits cannot?
61f6b9083c00.zh: 第三章：门、张量积与纠缠。两个量子比特能做到哪些两个比特做不到的事？

816843a1feb8.en: A one-qubit gate is a two by two unitary matrix: on the Bloch sphere, a rotation. <bookmark mark='a'/> The Hadamard gate is a half turn about the axis between x and z, carrying zero to plus. <bookmark mark='b'/> The T gate puts a phase of an eighth of a turn on the one amplitude: an eighth of a turn about the vertical axis. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two T gates make S, a quarter turn, to plus i. <bookmark mark='d'/> A half turn about x carries zero to one: a quantum NOT. <bookmark mark='e'/> Unitary means U dagger times U is the identity: lengths are kept, so probabilities still sum to one, and every gate can be undone.
816843a1feb8.zh: 单量子比特门是一个2乘2的酉矩阵：在 Bloch 球上，就是一次旋转。<bookmark mark='a'/>Hadamard 门是绕 x 和 z 之间那根轴转半圈，把零变成加态。<bookmark mark='b'/>T 门在一的振幅上加一个八分之一圈的相位：绕竖直轴转八分之一圈。<bookmark mark='c'/>两个 T 门组成 S 门，转四分之一圈，到加 i 态。<bookmark mark='d'/>绕 x 轴转半圈，把零变成一：一个量子的非门。<bookmark mark='e'/>酉的意思是，U 的共轭转置乘以 U 等于单位矩阵：长度保持不变，所以概率之和仍然是1，而且每个门都可以撤销。

673037da8900.en: Now two qubits. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two independent qubits are described by the tensor product of their states. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiplied out: one amplitude for each of the four outcomes. <bookmark mark='c'/> But any four amplitudes whose squares sum to one are allowed, not only those that factor. <bookmark mark='d'/> Each qubit doubles the count: n qubits have two to the n amplitudes. <bookmark mark='e'/> A product state needs only two n numbers. A state that does not factor is entangled, and in general needs all two to the n: that is why Feynman's simulation runs out of memory.
673037da8900.zh: 现在看两个量子比特。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个独立的量子比特，由它们状态的张量积来描述。<bookmark mark='b'/>乘出来：四种结果各有一个振幅。<bookmark mark='c'/>但任何平方和为1的四个振幅都是允许的，不只是那些能分解成乘积的。<bookmark mark='d'/>每多一个量子比特，数目就翻一倍：n 个量子比特有2的 n 次方个振幅。<bookmark mark='e'/>一个乘积态只需要2n 个数。不能分解的状态是纠缠的，一般需要全部2的 n 次方个数：这就是 Feynman 的模拟会耗尽内存的原因。

b8da05641c60.en: The basic two-qubit gate is the controlled-NOT, which flips the second qubit when the first is one. <bookmark mark='a'/> Start with both qubits at zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> A Hadamard on the first gives equal amplitudes on zero zero and one zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> The CNOT turns one zero into one one. Our simulator gives half a chance of zero zero, half of one one, and nothing else: a Bell state. <bookmark mark='d'/> Is it two separate qubits? Then alpha delta is zero, so alpha or delta is zero, and one of the surviving amplitudes would vanish too. Contradiction: the state is entangled. <bookmark mark='e'/> Measure either qubit: the result is random, but the other always agrees.
b8da05641c60.zh: 基本的双量子比特门是受控非门（CNOT），当第一个量子比特为一时，它翻转第二个。<bookmark mark='a'/>让两个量子比特都从零开始。<bookmark mark='b'/>对第一个做一次 Hadamard，零零和一零就得到相等的振幅。<bookmark mark='c'/>CNOT 把一零变成一一。我们的模拟器给出：一半的机会是零零，一半是一一，没有别的：这是一个 Bell 态。<bookmark mark='d'/>它是两个分开的量子比特吗？那样的话，α δ 等于零，所以 α 或 δ 为零，那么留下来的某个振幅也会消失。矛盾：这个状态是纠缠的。<bookmark mark='e'/>测量任何一个量子比特：结果是随机的，但另一个总是与它一致。

0a56beeb6472.en: Agreeing on random bits is easy: toss a coin in advance. This game needs more. <bookmark mark='a'/> A referee sends Alice a random bit x and Bob a random bit y, and they cannot talk. They win if the XOR of their answers equals x AND y: they must agree, unless both questions were one. <bookmark mark='b'/> A classical strategy fixes an answer for each question. <bookmark mark='c'/> XOR the four conditions. On the left each answer appears twice and cancels; on the right we get one. So at most three can hold. <bookmark mark='d'/> No classical strategy wins more than three quarters of the time, and our search through all sixteen confirms it.
0a56beeb6472.zh: 在随机位上达成一致很容易：事先抛一枚硬币就行。这个游戏需要的更多。<bookmark mark='a'/>裁判随机发给 Alice 一位 x，发给 Bob 一位 y，两人不能交流。如果他们答案的异或等于 x 且 y，他们就赢：他们必须一致，除非两个问题都是一。<bookmark mark='b'/>经典策略为每个问题固定一个答案。<bookmark mark='c'/>把四个条件异或起来。左边每个答案都出现两次，相互抵消；右边得到一。所以至多三个能成立。<bookmark mark='d'/>没有任何经典策略的胜率能超过四分之三，我们对全部16种策略的搜索证实了这一点。

0a632c25921d.en: Give Alice and Bob one qubit each of a Bell pair. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each measures along an angle set by the question; they agree with probability cosine squared of the difference. <bookmark mark='b'/> Alice uses zero or forty-five degrees, Bob plus or minus twenty-two and a half. In three cases the angles differ by twenty-two and a half degrees: agreement with probability cosine squared of pi over eight. <bookmark mark='c'/> In the fourth they differ by sixty-seven and a half, and disagree just as often. <bookmark mark='d'/> About eighty-five percent against seventy-five; our simulator agrees. No message passes. <bookmark mark='e'/> Boris Tsirelson proved in 1980 that no quantum strategy does better, and Part 27's MIP equals RE grew from games like this.
0a632c25921d.zh: 给 Alice 和 Bob 各一个 Bell 对中的量子比特。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个人沿着由问题决定的角度测量；他们一致的概率是两角之差的余弦平方。<bookmark mark='b'/>Alice 用0度或45度，Bob 用正负22.5度。在三种情况下，两个角相差22.5度：一致的概率是八分之 π 的余弦平方。<bookmark mark='c'/>在第四种情况下，它们相差67.5度，不一致的概率也恰好一样高。<bookmark mark='d'/>大约百分之85，对百分之75；我们的模拟器也这么说。没有传递任何消息。<bookmark mark='e'/>Boris Tsirelson 在1980年证明，没有任何量子策略能做得更好，而第27部分的 MIP* 等于 RE，正是从这样的游戏里成长起来的。

92beb8876e10.en: No quantum computer can copy an unknown state; the proof takes three lines. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose one unitary machine copies every state: psi to psi psi, phi to phi phi. <bookmark mark='b'/> Take the inner product of the two lines. Unitaries preserve it, so the overlap of phi and psi equals its own square. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the overlap is zero or one: one machine copies only states that are identical or orthogonal. <bookmark mark='d'/> CNOT copies zero and one perfectly, but fed plus it makes a Bell pair, not two pluses: our simulator puts the overlap at one half. <bookmark mark='e'/> This made error correction look impossible, and it is why eavesdroppers get caught.
92beb8876e10.zh: 没有任何量子计算机能复制一个未知的状态；证明只要三行。<bookmark mark='a'/>假设有一台酉机器能复制每一个状态：ψ 变成 ψ ψ，φ 变成 φ φ。<bookmark mark='b'/>取这两行的内积。酉变换保持内积，所以 φ 和 ψ 的重叠等于它自己的平方。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以重叠是0或1：一台机器只能复制那些相同或者正交的状态。<bookmark mark='d'/>CNOT 能完美地复制零和一，但输入加态时，它做出的是一个 Bell 对，而不是两个加态：我们的模拟器算出重叠是二分之一。<bookmark mark='e'/>这曾让纠错看起来不可能，也正是窃听者会被抓住的原因。

27e22e901534.en: Chapter four. Circuits and universality. Which gates are enough?
27e22e901534.zh: 第四章：电路与通用性。哪些门就够用了？

337edf62e29f.en: Deutsch's quantum circuit model of 1989 is the standard one. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each wire is a qubit, and time runs left to right: here a Hadamard, a CNOT, a T gate, and measurements. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each step is a unitary matrix and the circuit is their product. Matrices act right to left, so the first gate is written last. <bookmark mark='c'/> A gate on one qubit of two is a tensor product with the identity. <bookmark mark='d'/> Written out, each entry of H multiplies a copy of the identity: four by four. With n qubits these matrices are two to the n on a side, so no simulator builds them.
337edf62e29f.zh: Deutsch 1989年的量子电路模型，是标准的模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>每根线是一个量子比特，时间从左向右流：这里是一个 Hadamard、一个 CNOT、一个 T 门，以及测量。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一步是一个酉矩阵，电路就是它们的乘积。矩阵从右向左作用，所以第一个门写在最后。<bookmark mark='c'/>两个量子比特中只作用于其中一个的门，是它与单位矩阵的张量积。<bookmark mark='d'/>写出来，H 的每个元素乘以一份单位矩阵：4乘4。有 n 个量子比特时，这些矩阵每边是2的 n 次方，所以没有哪个模拟器会真的构造它们。

22f327c52962.en: Which gates do we need? <bookmark mark='a'/> Take chapter one's Toffoli gate. <bookmark mark='b'/> It can be built from Hadamards, T gates and their inverses, and CNOTs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Six CNOTs, seven T gates and two Hadamards; multiplied out on our simulator, it is exactly Toffoli's permutation. So anything a classical computer does, a quantum computer can do. <bookmark mark='d'/> In 1995 Adriano Barenco and colleagues showed that CNOT with arbitrary one-qubit gates builds any unitary exactly. <bookmark mark='e'/> The catch is the word arbitrary: one-qubit gates form a continuum, but a real machine offers a short, fixed menu.
22f327c52962.zh: 我们需要哪些门？<bookmark mark='a'/>拿第一章的托福利门来说。<bookmark mark='b'/>它可以用 Hadamard 门、T 门及其逆，以及 CNOT 搭出来。<bookmark mark='c'/>6个 CNOT、7个 T 门和2个 Hadamard；在我们的模拟器上乘出来，它恰好就是托福利门的置换。所以经典计算机能做的任何事，量子计算机都能做。<bookmark mark='d'/>1995年，Adriano Barenco 和同事们证明，CNOT 加上任意的单量子比特门，能精确地搭出任何酉矩阵。<bookmark mark='e'/>麻烦在于“任意”这个词：单量子比特门构成一个连续统，但真实的机器只提供一份简短而固定的菜单。

a9635a24ef81.en: Can two fixed gates, H and T, approximate every rotation? <bookmark mark='a'/> Take the product T H T H. <bookmark mark='b'/> H T H is an eighth of a turn about x, and T an eighth of a turn about z. <bookmark mark='c'/> Together they make one rotation, by an angle that is an irrational fraction of a turn. <bookmark mark='d'/> So its powers never return to the start: applied again and again to zero, the points fill a circle around its axis densely. Conjugating by H gives a second axis, and products of the two approach any rotation. <bookmark mark='e'/> T is essential: without it, circuits of H, S and CNOT can be simulated efficiently on an ordinary computer. That is the Gottesman–Knill theorem.
a9635a24ef81.zh: 两个固定的门，H 和 T，能逼近每一个旋转吗？<bookmark mark='a'/>取乘积 T H T H。<bookmark mark='b'/>H T H 是绕 x 轴转八分之一圈，T 是绕 z 轴转八分之一圈。<bookmark mark='c'/>两者合起来成为一个旋转，转角是一圈的一个无理数倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以它的幂永远不会回到起点：对零一次又一次地作用，这些点会稠密地填满绕它的轴的一个圆。用 H 做共轭，得到第二根轴，而两者的乘积能逼近任何旋转。<bookmark mark='e'/>T 是必不可少的：没有它，由 H、S 和 CNOT 组成的电路，能在普通计算机上被高效地模拟。这就是 Gottesman–Knill 定理。

3e615ffa11ae.en: But we also want few gates. Robert Solovay and Alexei Kitaev showed, independently, that the count grows only like a power of log one over the accuracy. <bookmark mark='a'/> The proof is a recursion: approximate roughly, then cancel the small leftover error with a commutator of two rotations of about its square root, each approximated one level down. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each level raises the error to the power three halves and multiplies the length by five. <bookmark mark='c'/> Unroll k levels. <bookmark mark='d'/> Reaching accuracy epsilon needs three halves to the k to grow like log one over epsilon. <bookmark mark='e'/> So the length grows like that logarithm to the power about four. For H and T, later number-theoretic methods need only a multiple of the logarithm.
3e615ffa11ae.zh: 但我们还希望门少。Robert Solovay 和 Alexei Kitaev 各自独立地证明，门的数目只按1除以精度的对数的某个幂增长。<bookmark mark='a'/>证明是一个递归：先粗略地逼近，再用两个大约是剩余误差平方根大小的旋转的对易子，消去这个小误差，而这两个旋转各自在下一层被逼近。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一层把误差提升到二分之三次方，并把长度乘以5。<bookmark mark='c'/>展开 k 层。<bookmark mark='d'/>要达到精度 ε，需要二分之三的 k 次方像1除以 ε 的对数那样增长。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以长度按这个对数的大约4次方增长。对 H 和 T，后来的数论方法只需要这个对数的一个倍数。

ce68304e5603.en: Every result in this part comes from a simulator of about a hundred lines. <bookmark mark='a'/> It keeps all two to the n amplitudes in one array. To apply a gate it views the array as a cube with one axis per qubit, moves the gate's axes to the front, multiplies by the small matrix, and moves them back. <bookmark mark='b'/> A gate on one qubit mixes amplitudes in pairs whose indices differ only in that qubit's bit. <bookmark mark='c'/> On the first qubit the partners are four apart: one stage of Part 19's FFT butterfly, back in chapter seven. <bookmark mark='d'/> Every gate streams through all the amplitudes, sixteen bytes each, doing little arithmetic on each: memory-bound, on the wrong side of Part 9's roofline.
ce68304e5603.zh: 这一部分的每一个结果，都来自一个大约100行的模拟器。<bookmark mark='a'/>它把全部2的 n 次方个振幅存在一个数组里。要作用一个门，它把数组看成一个立方体，每个量子比特一根轴，把门的轴移到前面，乘以那个小矩阵，再把它们移回去。<bookmark mark='b'/>作用在一个量子比特上的门，成对地混合振幅，每对的下标只在那个量子比特的那一位上不同。<bookmark mark='c'/>在第一个量子比特上，配对的伙伴相隔4：这是第19部分 FFT 蝶形的一级，会在第七章再次出现。<bookmark mark='d'/>每个门都要流过所有振幅，每个16字节，在每个上只做很少的算术：受内存带宽限制，落在第9部分屋顶线的错误一侧。

02f76c397bdd.en: Real programs use libraries that build these same circuits. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is chapter three's Bell circuit on our simulator, in IBM's Qiskit, and in Google's Cirq. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our simulator prints the amplitudes: nought point seven zero seven on zero zero and on one one. <bookmark mark='c'/> A real device never shows those. It returns samples of the measured bits, about half zero zero and half one one. <bookmark mark='d'/> And before a circuit runs, a compiler rewrites it into the machine's native gates, routing each two-qubit gate to physically connected qubits, inserting swaps where needed.
02f76c397bdd.zh: 真实的程序使用构造同样电路的库。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是第三章的 Bell 电路，分别写在我们的模拟器、IBM 的 Qiskit 和 Google 的 Cirq 里。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的模拟器打印出振幅：零零和一一上都是0.707。<bookmark mark='c'/>真实的设备从不显示这些。它返回的是被测量位的样本，大约一半零零，一半一一。<bookmark mark='d'/>而在电路运行之前，编译器会把它改写成机器的原生门，把每个双量子比特门安排到物理上相连的量子比特上，在需要的地方插入交换门。

2db819a4f0fe.en: Chapter five. Interference as a resource. Where does a quantum speed-up come from?
2db819a4f0fe.zh: 第五章：作为资源的干涉。量子加速从哪里来？

2b931d44197a.en: <bookmark mark='a'/> Flip a fair coin, then flip it again. Probabilities multiply along each path and add across paths, and after two flips the outcome is still a coin flip. <bookmark mark='b'/> Now apply a Hadamard to zero, twice. Amplitudes also multiply along paths and add across them, but they carry signs. One path to one picks up a minus sign. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the two paths to one cancel, and the two paths to zero reinforce: the result is zero, with certainty. <bookmark mark='d'/> The algebra says the same in two lines. That cancellation is interference, and a randomized algorithm, whose probabilities can only add, cannot do it.
2b931d44197a.zh: <bookmark mark='a'/>抛一枚公平的硬币，再抛一次。概率沿着每条路径相乘，在路径之间相加，抛两次之后，结果仍然是一次抛硬币。<bookmark mark='b'/>现在对零作用两次 Hadamard。振幅也沿着路径相乘、在路径之间相加，但它们带着符号。通向一的一条路径带上了一个负号。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以通向一的两条路径相互抵消，通向零的两条路径相互加强：结果是零，而且是确定的。<bookmark mark='d'/>代数用两行说的是同一件事。这种抵消就是干涉，而随机化算法的概率只能相加，做不到这一点。

da94adad293c.en: First we need the function as a gate. <bookmark mark='a'/> The oracle maps x and y to x and y exclusive-or f of x. It is reversible, and chapter one's compute, copy, uncompute builds it from any classical circuit without leaving garbage behind. <bookmark mark='b'/> Now feed the target the minus state. <bookmark mark='c'/> If f of x is zero, nothing flips. If f of x is one, the two terms of the minus state swap places, which is the same state times minus one. <bookmark mark='d'/> Either way the target comes out unchanged, and the input has picked up a sign, minus one to the f of x. The answer has been kicked back into the phase. On a single basis state a sign is invisible, but in a superposition it is a relative sign, and relative signs interfere.
da94adad293c.zh: 首先，我们需要把函数做成一个门。<bookmark mark='a'/>谕示把 x 和 y 映到 x 和 y 异或 f(x)。它是可逆的，而第一章的计算、复制、反计算，能从任何经典电路把它搭出来，不留下垃圾。<bookmark mark='b'/>现在把目标量子比特置为减态。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果 f(x) 是零，什么都不翻转。如果 f(x) 是一，减态的两项交换位置，这就等于同一个状态乘以负1。<bookmark mark='d'/>无论哪种情况，目标出来时都没有改变，而输入带上了一个符号：负1的 f(x) 次方。答案被反冲到了相位里。在单个基态上，符号是看不见的，但在叠加态里，它是一个相对符号，而相对符号会干涉。

db4124763176.en: David Deutsch's problem of 1985 is the first in which interference wins. <bookmark mark='a'/> A function takes one bit to one bit. Are its two values equal? Classically you must evaluate it twice. <bookmark mark='b'/> Put the input qubit in an equal superposition and the target in the minus state. <bookmark mark='c'/> One query kicks both answers into the phases at once. Factor out the first sign, and what remains has a plus where the values agree and a minus where they differ. <bookmark mark='d'/> A final Hadamard turns plus into zero and minus into one. <bookmark mark='e'/> Constant functions always give zero, balanced ones always give one, from a single query. The circuit never learns either value of f, only the one fact we asked for.
db4124763176.zh: David Deutsch 1985年的问题，是干涉获胜的第一个问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个函数把一位映到一位。它的两个值相等吗？在经典计算里，你必须求值两次。<bookmark mark='b'/>把输入量子比特置于等权叠加，把目标置于减态。<bookmark mark='c'/>一次查询就把两个答案同时反冲进相位。提出第一个符号，剩下的部分在两个值一致时是加号，不同时是减号。<bookmark mark='d'/>最后一个 Hadamard 把加变成零，把减变成一。<bookmark mark='e'/>常数函数总是给出零，平衡函数总是给出一，只要一次查询。这个电路从来没有得知 f 的任何一个值，只得知我们问的那一个事实。

a13f51c9c70a.en: In 1992 Deutsch and Richard Jozsa scaled this up to n bits. The function is promised to be either constant, or balanced, zero on exactly half its inputs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Hadamards on four qubits give sixteen equal amplitudes. <bookmark mark='b'/> The oracle stamps a sign on each, and Hadamards again bring them together. For a constant function every sign agrees, and all the amplitude piles onto zero zero zero zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> For a balanced function, the signs cancel exactly there, and the amplitude lands somewhere else, a different place for each function. <bookmark mark='d'/> Why? The amplitude of all zeros after the last Hadamards is the average of the signs: plus or minus one if f is constant, zero if it is balanced. <bookmark mark='e'/> Our simulator measures all zeros with probability one or zero. A deterministic classical algorithm would need nine evaluations in the worst case; this needs one.
a13f51c9c70a.zh: 1992年，Deutsch 和 Richard Jozsa 把它推广到 n 位。函数被承诺要么是常数，要么是平衡的，也就是恰好在一半的输入上为零。<bookmark mark='a'/>对四个量子比特做 Hadamard，得到16个相等的振幅。<bookmark mark='b'/>谕示在每一个上盖上一个符号，再做一次 Hadamard，把它们汇到一起。对常数函数，每个符号都一致，所有振幅都堆到零零零零上。<bookmark mark='c'/>对平衡函数，符号恰好在那里相互抵消，振幅落到别的地方，每个函数落到不同的地方。<bookmark mark='d'/>为什么？最后一组 Hadamard 之后，全零的振幅是各个符号的平均值：f 是常数时为正负1，是平衡的时为零。<bookmark mark='e'/>我们的模拟器测到全零的概率，要么是1，要么是0。确定性的经典算法在最坏情况下需要9次求值；这里只需要1次。

8886558021ec.en: This is the recipe for the next five chapters. <bookmark mark='a'/> Spread out over every input with Hadamards; mark each input's answer in its phase with the oracle; then apply a transform under which the wrong answers cancel. <bookmark mark='b'/> It is tempting to say a quantum computer tries every answer in parallel. But measure right after the oracle and you get one random input and its value, no better than one classical query. The gain is all in the third step. <bookmark mark='c'/> And we should be honest about Deutsch–Jozsa. Its advantage is over certainty. A randomized classical test that checks k random inputs is fooled by a balanced function with probability at most two to the one minus k. Ten queries, and it is almost never wrong. An exponential gap against randomized algorithms needs a harder problem, and Daniel Simon found one.
8886558021ec.zh: 这就是接下来五章的配方。<bookmark mark='a'/>用 Hadamard 铺开到每一个输入上；用谕示把每个输入的答案标记在它的相位里；然后作用一个变换，让错误的答案在其中相互抵消。<bookmark mark='b'/>人们很容易说，量子计算机是在并行地尝试每一个答案。但在谕示之后立刻测量，你得到的是一个随机的输入和它的值，不比一次经典查询更好。全部的收益都在第三步。<bookmark mark='c'/>而对 Deutsch–Jozsa，我们应该诚实。它的优势只是相对于必须确定无误的算法而言的。一个检查 k 个随机输入的随机化经典测试，被平衡函数骗过的概率至多是2的1减 k 次方。查询10次，它几乎从不出错。要对随机化算法取得指数级的差距，需要一个更难的问题，而 Daniel Simon 找到了一个。

3991cc10b154.en: Chapter six. Bernstein–Vazirani and Simon. Can a quantum computer be exponentially faster?
3991cc10b154.zh: 第六章：Bernstein–Vazirani 与 Simon。量子计算机能快上指数倍吗？

e20c8adc5708.en: Ethan Bernstein and Umesh Vazirani, in 1993, hid a whole string in a function. <bookmark mark='a'/> The function takes x to the parity of the bits that x shares with a secret string s. <bookmark mark='b'/> Classically each query returns one bit, so the best you can do is ask about one position at a time: four queries for four bits, n for n. <bookmark mark='c'/> Quantumly, run the same circuit as Deutsch–Jozsa. The oracle stamps the sign minus one to the s dot x on every input. <bookmark mark='d'/> But that pattern of signs is exactly what Hadamards make from the string s, by chapter five's formula read backwards. <bookmark mark='e'/> Hadamard undoes itself, so the final Hadamards return s. <bookmark mark='f'/> Our simulator measures one zero one one, the secret, with probability one, from a single query.
e20c8adc5708.zh: 1993年，Ethan Bernstein 和 Umesh Vazirani 把一整个字符串藏进了一个函数里。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个函数把 x 映到 x 与一个秘密字符串 s 共有的那些位的奇偶性。<bookmark mark='b'/>在经典计算里，每次查询返回一位，所以你最多只能一次问一个位置：4位要4次查询，n 位要 n 次。<bookmark mark='c'/>在量子计算里，运行和 Deutsch–Jozsa 同样的电路。谕示在每个输入上盖上符号：负1的 s 点乘 x 次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>而这个符号的模式，恰好就是 Hadamard 从字符串 s 生成的模式，把第五章的公式倒过来读就知道。<bookmark mark='e'/>Hadamard 是自己的逆，所以最后一组 Hadamard 返回 s。<bookmark mark='f'/>我们的模拟器以概率1测到一零一一，也就是那个秘密，只用了一次查询。

1733dbb054b3.en: In 1994 Daniel Simon found a problem with an exponential gap. <bookmark mark='a'/> A function on n-bit strings is promised to be two-to-one in a special way: two inputs collide exactly when they differ by a hidden string s, under exclusive-or. Find s. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here are the eight inputs for three bits. Each colour is a pair, x and x exclusive-or s. <bookmark mark='c'/> Classically the only clue is a collision, two inputs with the same output; their exclusive-or is s. With q queries there are about q squared over two pairs, each a collision with probability one in one less than two to the n. <bookmark mark='d'/> So the first collision needs about two to the n over two queries. That is Part 17's birthday bound, and Simon proved that no classical algorithm, even a randomized one, does much better.
1733dbb054b3.zh: 1994年，Daniel Simon 找到了一个有指数级差距的问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个定义在 n 位字符串上的函数，被承诺以一种特殊的方式二对一：两个输入发生碰撞，恰好当它们按异或相差一个隐藏字符串 s。求 s。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是三位时的八个输入。每种颜色是一对：x 和 x 异或 s。<bookmark mark='c'/>在经典计算里，唯一的线索是碰撞，即两个输入有相同的输出；它们的异或就是 s。q 次查询大约有 q 平方除以2个配对，每一对是碰撞的概率是2的 n 次方减1分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以第一次碰撞大约需要2的二分之 n 次方次查询。这就是第17部分的生日界，而 Simon 证明，没有任何经典算法，哪怕是随机化的，能做得好很多。

02714d121c79.en: Simon's circuit has two registers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Hadamards spread the first over every input, and one query writes f of x into the second. <bookmark mark='b'/> Suppose the second register reads some value. Two inputs give that value, x nought and x nought exclusive-or s, so the first register is left in an equal superposition of exactly those two. <bookmark mark='c'/> Apply Hadamards again. Each output y receives two contributions, with signs that agree when y dot s is zero and are opposite when it is one. <bookmark mark='d'/> So every y with y dot s equal to one cancels. <bookmark mark='e'/> What survives, all with equal probability, are the y orthogonal to s. One run gives one random linear equation that s must satisfy.
02714d121c79.zh: Simon 的电路有两个寄存器。<bookmark mark='a'/>Hadamard 把第一个寄存器铺开到每一个输入上，一次查询把 f(x) 写进第二个寄存器。<bookmark mark='b'/>假设第二个寄存器读出某个值。有两个输入给出这个值，x0 和 x0 异或 s，所以第一个寄存器留在恰好这两者的等权叠加里。<bookmark mark='c'/>再做一次 Hadamard。每个输出 y 得到两份贡献，当 y 点乘 s 为零时符号一致，为一时符号相反。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以每个 y 点乘 s 等于一的 y 都被抵消。<bookmark mark='e'/>留下来的，概率全都相等，是那些与 s 正交的 y。运行一次，就得到 s 必须满足的一个随机线性方程。

ee9e55846d60.en: Now collect equations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Our simulator's first run gave one one zero: so the first two bits of s are equal. The second gave nought nought one: the last bit of s is zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch the candidates. Seven nonzero strings could be s. The first equation rules out four of them, the second rules out two more. <bookmark mark='c'/> One is left, one one zero, and it is the hidden string. <bookmark mark='d'/> In general n minus one independent equations determine s. Each run gives a new independent equation with probability at least a half, and on average a little over n runs are enough, <bookmark mark='e'/> and Gaussian elimination, modulo two, finishes the job: polynomial in n, against the classical two to the n over two.
ee9e55846d60.zh: 现在收集方程。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的模拟器第一次运行给出一一零：所以 s 的前两位相等。第二次给出零零一：s 的最后一位是零。<bookmark mark='b'/>看着候选者。有7个非零字符串可能是 s。第一个方程排除了其中4个，第二个又排除了2个。<bookmark mark='c'/>剩下一个，一一零，它就是那个隐藏的字符串。<bookmark mark='d'/>一般来说，n 减1个独立的方程决定 s。每次运行以至少一半的概率给出一个新的独立方程，平均来说，比 n 次多一点的运行就够了，<bookmark mark='e'/>再用模二的高斯消去法收尾：对 n 是多项式的，而经典的是2的二分之 n 次方。

2dadace00f78.en: Simon's result was the first exponential separation between quantum and randomized classical computation. <bookmark mark='a'/> On a logarithmic scale the gap is plain: the classical cost is two to the n over two, a straight line climbing steeply, while the quantum cost grows like n. <bookmark mark='b'/> And Simon's algorithm has exactly the shape of the one Peter Shor published the same year. Replace exclusive-or by ordinary addition, and the hidden string by a hidden period r; replace the Hadamards by the quantum Fourier transform, and linear algebra by continued fractions. <bookmark mark='c'/> Both find a hidden period of a function on a group, and the same recipe solves that for every abelian group. <bookmark mark='d'/> One caution. The separation is relative to a black box. It does not prove that quantum computers beat classical ones on any problem stated without one, as chapter eleven explains.
2dadace00f78.zh: Simon 的结果，是量子计算与随机化经典计算之间第一个指数级的分离。<bookmark mark='a'/>在对数坐标上，差距一目了然：经典代价是2的二分之 n 次方，一条陡峭上升的直线，而量子代价像 n 那样增长。<bookmark mark='b'/>而 Simon 的算法，和 Peter Shor 同一年发表的那个算法有着完全相同的形状。把异或换成普通的加法，把隐藏字符串换成隐藏的周期 r；把 Hadamard 换成量子傅里叶变换，把线性代数换成连分数。<bookmark mark='c'/>两者都是在一个群上寻找函数的隐藏周期，而同样的配方能对每一个阿贝尔群解决这个问题。<bookmark mark='d'/>有一点要小心。这个分离是相对于一个黑盒而言的。它并不证明，在任何不借助黑盒来陈述的问题上，量子计算机都胜过经典计算机，第十一章会解释这一点。

38807a6a640b.en: Chapter seven. The quantum Fourier transform. Can two to the n amplitudes be transformed with about n squared gates?
38807a6a640b.zh: 第七章：量子傅里叶变换。2的 n 次方个振幅，能用大约 n 平方个门来变换吗？

62041fc3b830.en: Part 19 met the discrete Fourier transform, and the fast algorithm that computes it. <bookmark mark='a'/> The quantum version is the same transform applied to amplitudes: basis state j goes to an equal superposition of every k, with phase omega to the j k. <bookmark mark='b'/> Omega is a root of unity, a fraction of a turn round the circle; for eight points, an eighth of a turn. <bookmark mark='c'/> Draw each entry of the matrix as an arrow at its phase. Row one turns an eighth of a turn per column, row two a quarter, and so on. <bookmark mark='d'/> It is exactly Part 19's matrix, scaled by one over root N so that it is unitary. Classically, the FFT needs about N log N operations on N numbers. For two to the n numbers, that is exponential in n.
62041fc3b830.zh: 第19部分认识了离散傅里叶变换，以及计算它的快速算法。<bookmark mark='a'/>量子版本是作用在振幅上的同一个变换：基态 j 变成每一个 k 的等权叠加，相位是 ω 的 j k 次方。<bookmark mark='b'/>ω 是一个单位根，绕圆周的若干分之一圈；对8个点，是八分之一圈。<bookmark mark='c'/>把矩阵的每个元素画成一根指向它的相位的箭头。第一行每列转八分之一圈，第二行转四分之一圈，依此类推。<bookmark mark='d'/>它恰好就是第19部分的矩阵，乘以根号 N 分之一，好让它是酉的。在经典计算里，FFT 对 N 个数需要大约 N log N 次运算。对2的 n 次方个数，这对 n 是指数级的。

5d92953757a9.en: Here is the fact that makes the quantum transform cheap. <bookmark mark='a'/> Write the output index k in binary. The phase of each term splits into one factor per bit of k, <bookmark mark='b'/> and a sum over all bit strings of a product is a product of sums. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the transform of a basis state is a product of n single qubits, each an equal mix of zero and one with its own phase. <bookmark mark='d'/> Whole turns do nothing, so the l-th qubit's phase only sees the last l bits of j, read as a binary fraction. <bookmark mark='e'/> For j equals five on three qubits: half a turn, a quarter turn, and five eighths. Nothing is entangled. Each output qubit needs only a Hadamard and a few rotations.
5d92953757a9.zh: 这就是让量子变换变得便宜的那个事实。<bookmark mark='a'/>把输出下标 k 写成二进制。每一项的相位分裂成因子，k 的每一位各一个，<bookmark mark='b'/>而对所有位串求一个乘积的和，等于一组和的乘积。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以一个基态的变换，是 n 个单量子比特的乘积，每一个都是零和一的等权混合，带着各自的相位。<bookmark mark='d'/>整圈不起作用，所以第 l 个量子比特的相位只看见 j 的最后 l 位，读成一个二进制小数。<bookmark mark='e'/>对三个量子比特上的 j 等于5：半圈、四分之一圈，以及八分之五圈。没有任何东西是纠缠的。每个输出量子比特只需要一个 Hadamard 和几次旋转。

7750205df325.en: The circuit comes straight from Part 19's fast Fourier transform. <bookmark mark='a'/> The FFT works in stages. Each stage combines entries in pairs that differ in one bit of their index: a butterfly. <bookmark mark='b'/> On a quantum computer, mixing every pair that differs in one bit is a single gate, a Hadamard on that qubit, as chapter four's simulator showed. <bookmark mark='c'/> Between stages the FFT multiplies by twiddle factors, powers of omega that depend on the other bits of the index. Those become phase rotations controlled by the other qubits. <bookmark mark='d'/> And in this form of the FFT the outputs emerge in bit-reversed order, which the circuit fixes with swaps at the end. Each stage of N over two butterflies has become a single Hadamard.
7750205df325.zh: 这个电路直接来自第19部分的快速傅里叶变换。<bookmark mark='a'/>FFT 分级进行。每一级把下标只差一位的元素成对组合：一个蝶形。<bookmark mark='b'/>在量子计算机上，混合每一对只差一位的元素，就是一个单独的门：对那个量子比特做一次 Hadamard，正如第四章的模拟器所展示的。<bookmark mark='c'/>在两级之间，FFT 要乘以旋转因子，也就是 ω 的幂，取决于下标的其他位。它们变成了由其他量子比特控制的相位旋转。<bookmark mark='d'/>在这种形式的 FFT 里，输出按位反转的顺序出现，电路在末尾用交换门来修正。每一级的 N 除以2个蝶形，变成了一个单独的 Hadamard。

18f7e0de2153.en: Count the gates. <bookmark mark='a'/> On four qubits: the first gets a Hadamard and three controlled rotations, the next a Hadamard and two, and so on down, then two swaps. <bookmark mark='b'/> Qubit l needs one Hadamard and n minus l rotations, so the total is n times n plus one over two, plus n over two swaps: order n squared gates for two to the n points. <bookmark mark='c'/> Our simulator runs this circuit on a random state and compares it with numpy's FFT. They agree to rounding error, about ten to the minus sixteen. <bookmark mark='d'/> On eight qubits the circuit has forty gates, where the FFT needs two thousand and forty-eight operations, and the gap grows exponentially with n.
18f7e0de2153.zh: 数一数门。<bookmark mark='a'/>在四个量子比特上：第一个得到一个 Hadamard 和三个受控旋转，下一个得到一个 Hadamard 和两个，依此类推，最后是两个交换。<bookmark mark='b'/>第 l 个量子比特需要一个 Hadamard 和 n 减 l 个旋转，所以总数是 n 乘以 n 加1再除以2，加上 n 除以2个交换：对2的 n 次方个点，是 n 平方量级的门。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们的模拟器在一个随机状态上运行这个电路，并与 numpy 的 FFT 比较。两者在舍入误差范围内一致，大约是10的负16次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>在8个量子比特上，电路有40个门，而 FFT 需要2048次运算，而且这个差距随 n 指数级增长。

37250172c654.en: So what is it good for? <bookmark mark='a'/> Feed it a periodic state: four equal amplitudes, four apart, starting at one. <bookmark mark='b'/> After the transform, all the amplitude sits on multiples of sixteen over four, and everything between has interfered away. The offset has moved into the phases, shown here as colour, and the period into where the peaks are. <bookmark mark='c'/> A measurement then samples a multiple of N over r, which is exactly what Shor's algorithm needs in chapter nine. <bookmark mark='d'/> What it is not good for: reading out Fourier coefficients. One run yields one sample. And loading arbitrary data into amplitudes costs as much as the data. <bookmark mark='e'/> In 1994 Don Coppersmith also showed that the tiniest rotations can be dropped, leaving order n log n gates for a close approximation.
37250172c654.zh: 那它有什么用？<bookmark mark='a'/>给它一个周期性的状态：四个相等的振幅，相隔4，从1开始。<bookmark mark='b'/>变换之后，全部振幅都落在16除以4的倍数上，中间的一切都被干涉掉了。偏移量跑进了相位里，这里用颜色表示，而周期跑进了峰的位置里。<bookmark mark='c'/>这时一次测量会采到 N 除以 r 的一个倍数，这正是第九章里 Shor 算法所需要的。<bookmark mark='d'/>它不适合做什么：读出傅里叶系数。运行一次只得到一个样本。而把任意数据装进振幅，代价和数据本身一样大。<bookmark mark='e'/>1994年，Don Coppersmith 还证明，最小的那些旋转可以去掉，只剩下 n log n 量级的门，得到一个很接近的近似。

c6d108949109.en: Chapter eight. Phase estimation. How do we read an eigenvalue?
c6d108949109.zh: 第八章：相位估计。我们怎样读出一个特征值？

4d1c897fc263.en: Every unitary has eigenvectors, states it only multiplies by a number. <bookmark mark='a'/> Because a unitary keeps lengths, that number has size one: it is a point on the unit circle, e to the two pi i theta. <bookmark mark='b'/> Applied to the eigenvector alone, the phase is global, and no measurement can see it. <bookmark mark='c'/> So control the unitary from a qubit in the plus state. The eigenvector comes out unchanged, and the phase is kicked back onto the control, as in chapter five. <bookmark mark='d'/> On the control's Bloch sphere, seen from above, its arrow turns about the vertical axis by two pi theta. Here theta is nought point three, a turn of a hundred and eight degrees. The question of this chapter is how to read that angle to many bits.
4d1c897fc263.zh: 每个酉矩阵都有特征向量，也就是它只乘以一个数的那些状态。<bookmark mark='a'/>因为酉矩阵保持长度，这个数的大小是1：它是单位圆上的一个点，e 的2π i θ 次方。<bookmark mark='b'/>只作用在特征向量上时，这个相位是全局的，任何测量都看不见它。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以让一个处于加态的量子比特来控制这个酉矩阵。特征向量出来时没有改变，而相位被反冲到控制量子比特上，就像第五章那样。<bookmark mark='d'/>在控制量子比特的 Bloch 球上，从上方看，它的箭头绕竖直轴转过2π θ。这里 θ 是0.3，也就是转108度。这一章的问题是：怎样把这个角读到许多位。

992fb8ef1274.en: One qubit turned by theta gives at best a bit or two of theta. To get many bits, ask more qubits. <bookmark mark='a'/> Put t counting qubits in the plus state. The first controls U once, the next U twice, then four times, and so on, doubling. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each control picks up two to the k times theta, with whole turns dropped. For theta nought point three: three tenths, six tenths, two tenths, four, eight, and six again. <bookmark mark='c'/> Doubling shifts the binary point of theta, so each qubit holds theta's bits from one place onward. <bookmark mark='d'/> Multiply the qubits out, and the state is a sum over j of e to the two pi i j theta. That is exactly the product form of chapter seven. If theta is m over two to the t, the counting register holds the Fourier transform of m.
992fb8ef1274.zh: 一个转过 θ 的量子比特，至多给出 θ 的一两位。要得到许多位，就去问更多的量子比特。<bookmark mark='a'/>把 t 个计数量子比特置于加态。第一个控制 U 一次，下一个控制 U 两次，然后四次，依此类推，不断加倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个控制量子比特得到2的 k 次方乘以 θ，去掉整圈。对 θ 等于0.3：十分之三、十分之六、十分之二、十分之四、十分之八，然后又是十分之六。<bookmark mark='c'/>加倍会移动 θ 的二进制小数点，所以每个量子比特存着 θ 从某一位开始往后的各位。<bookmark mark='d'/>把这些量子比特乘出来，状态就是对 j 求和的 e 的2π i j θ 次方。这恰好是第七章的乘积形式。如果 θ 等于 m 除以2的 t 次方，计数寄存器存的就是 m 的傅里叶变换。

ecdb6e7f86b3.en: Run the inverse Fourier transform on the counting register. <bookmark mark='a'/> The amplitude of outcome m is an average of T phases, each turning by theta minus m over T per step. <bookmark mark='b'/> Draw the terms as arrows, head to tail. For the m nearest to theta times T, they turn slowly and nearly line up, and the average is long. One outcome further on, they turn faster, curl most of the way round, and largely cancel. Interference again. <bookmark mark='c'/> The sum is a geometric series, and its size gives the probability of each outcome. <bookmark mark='d'/> For the nearest m, the leftover angle is at most half a step, and then the probability is at least four over pi squared, about forty per cent. In fact it is usually far more, and if theta is exactly m over T, it is one.
ecdb6e7f86b3.zh: 对计数寄存器运行逆傅里叶变换。<bookmark mark='a'/>结果 m 的振幅是 T 个相位的平均值，每一步转过 θ 减去 m 除以 T。<bookmark mark='b'/>把这些项画成首尾相接的箭头。对最接近 θ 乘以 T 的那个 m，它们转得很慢，几乎排成一条直线，平均值很长。再往外一个结果，它们转得更快，卷过大半圈，大部分相互抵消。又是干涉。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个和是一个几何级数，它的大小给出每个结果的概率。<bookmark mark='d'/>对最近的 m，剩下的角至多是半步，这时概率至少是 π 平方分之4，大约百分之40。事实上它通常要大得多，而如果 θ 恰好等于 m 除以 T，概率就是1。

25972ea51db7.en: Here is our simulator's run: theta nought point three, six counting qubits. <bookmark mark='a'/> The distribution over the sixty-four outcomes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Theta times sixty-four is nineteen point two, between two outcomes, and the peak is at nineteen, measured with probability nought point eight seven five. <bookmark mark='c'/> In binary that reads nought point nought one nought nought one one, nineteen sixty-fourths, nought point two nine six eight seven five: theta to six bits. <bookmark mark='d'/> Because nineteen point two is not a whole number, some probability leaks to the neighbours, twenty and eighteen. Each extra counting qubit halves the error, and a few more qubits than the bits we want make a wrong answer rare.
25972ea51db7.zh: 这是我们模拟器的一次运行：θ 等于0.3，6个计数量子比特。<bookmark mark='a'/>64个结果上的分布。<bookmark mark='b'/>θ 乘以64等于19.2，落在两个结果之间，峰在19，测到它的概率是0.875。<bookmark mark='c'/>用二进制读是0.010011，也就是六十四分之十九，0.296875：θ 精确到6位。<bookmark mark='d'/>因为19.2不是整数，有些概率泄漏到邻居20和18上。每多一个计数量子比特，误差减半，而比想要的位数多用几个量子比特，就能让错误的答案变得很少见。

212369edc57f.en: Phase estimation is the workhorse of quantum algorithms. <bookmark mark='a'/> Shor's algorithm in the next chapter is phase estimation of multiplication by a modulo N, whose eigenvalues reveal the order we need. <bookmark mark='b'/> In chemistry, the phases of a molecule's time evolution give its energy levels. <bookmark mark='c'/> Applied to Grover's rotation, it counts solutions. <bookmark mark='d'/> But precision is not free. The controlled powers apply U one, two, four, and up to thirty-two times: sixty-three applications for six bits, and each further bit doubles the work, unless the powers have a shortcut, as modular exponentiation does by repeated squaring. <bookmark mark='e'/> Alexei Kitaev's original version of 1995 used one control qubit at a time, estimating each doubled angle from repeated runs and combining the answers classically.
212369edc57f.zh: 相位估计是量子算法的主力。<bookmark mark='a'/>下一章的 Shor 算法，就是对模 N 乘以 a 这个运算做相位估计，它的特征值揭示出我们需要的阶。<bookmark mark='b'/>在化学中，一个分子时间演化的相位给出它的能级。<bookmark mark='c'/>作用在 Grover 的旋转上，它能数出解的个数。<bookmark mark='d'/>但精度不是免费的。受控的幂把 U 作用1次、2次、4次，一直到32次：6位要作用63次，每多一位，工作量就翻倍，除非这些幂有捷径，就像模幂运算可以靠反复平方那样。<bookmark mark='e'/>Alexei Kitaev 1995年的原始版本，一次只用一个控制量子比特，从重复的运行中估计每个加倍后的角，再用经典方法把答案组合起来。

5f0a6f750fbb.en: Chapter nine. Shor's algorithm. How does finding a period factor a number?
5f0a6f750fbb.zh: 第九章：Shor 算法。找到一个周期，怎样就能分解一个数？

04fb11428ba3.en: Part 30's RSA rests on factoring being hard. Shor reduced factoring to finding a period. <bookmark mark='a'/> List the powers of seven modulo fifteen: one, seven, four, thirteen, and then one again. The sequence repeats with period four, the order of seven. <bookmark mark='b'/> If the order r is even, a to the r minus one is a multiple of N, and it splits as a difference of squares. <bookmark mark='c'/> Unless a to the r over two is minus one, N divides neither bracket, so each shares a proper factor with N, and Euclid's algorithm finds it: forty-eight and fifty give three and five. <bookmark mark='d'/> A random a works at least half the time, and everything is fast except finding r.
04fb11428ba3.zh: 第30部分的 RSA 建立在因数分解很难之上。Shor 把因数分解归结为寻找周期。<bookmark mark='a'/>列出7模15的幂：1、7、4、13，然后又是1。这个序列以周期4重复，也就是7的阶。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果阶 r 是偶数，a 的 r 次方减1就是 N 的倍数，而它可以分解为平方差。<bookmark mark='c'/>除非 a 的二分之 r 次方等于负1，N 不整除任何一个括号，所以每个括号都和 N 共有一个真因子，欧几里得算法能找到它：48和50给出3和5。<bookmark mark='d'/>随机选的 a 至少有一半的时候管用，而除了找 r 之外，一切都很快。

e844edbaa177.en: Chapter eight promised that order finding is phase estimation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Multiplication by a modulo N is reversible, since a has an inverse, so it is a unitary, U. From one, it walks round a cycle: one, seven, four, thirteen, and back. <bookmark mark='b'/> Spread a state round the cycle, twisting its phase by s over r of a turn at each step. <bookmark mark='c'/> U moves every term one step on, and the twist comes out as a phase: an eigenvector, with eigenvalue e to the two pi i s over r. <bookmark mark='d'/> Add all r eigenvectors, and the twists cancel everywhere except at one. So the plain state one is an equal superposition of them. <bookmark mark='e'/> Phase estimation on it returns s over r, for a random s. The controlled powers come from repeated squaring, and this arithmetic, about n cubed gates, is most of the cost.
e844edbaa177.zh: 第八章承诺过，求阶就是相位估计。<bookmark mark='a'/>模 N 乘以 a 是可逆的，因为 a 有逆元，所以它是一个酉矩阵 U。从1出发，它沿着一个环走：1、7、4、13，再回来。<bookmark mark='b'/>把一个状态铺开在这个环上，每走一步，把它的相位扭转 r 分之 s 圈。<bookmark mark='c'/>U 把每一项向前移一步，而扭转作为一个相位出来：这是一个特征向量，特征值是 e 的2π i 乘 r 分之 s 次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>把全部 r 个特征向量加起来，扭转在除了1以外的每个地方都相互抵消。所以普通的状态1，就是它们的一个等权叠加。<bookmark mark='e'/>对它做相位估计，返回 r 分之 s，s 是随机的。受控的幂来自反复平方，而这部分算术，大约 n 的立方个门，占了大部分代价。

0ed80678f522.en: Our simulator factors fifteen, with a equal to seven, using nine counting qubits, twice fifteen's four bits plus one: five hundred and twelve outcomes. <bookmark mark='a'/> After the inverse Fourier transform, all the probability sits on four spikes, a quarter each, at the multiples of five hundred and twelve over four, as chapter seven predicted. <bookmark mark='b'/> Three hundred and eighty-four over five hundred and twelve is three quarters, and its denominator is the order, four. <bookmark mark='c'/> A shot at two hundred and fifty-six gives one half, because s and r shared a factor, and a shot at nought gives nothing. Nine of our twenty shots found four at once. <bookmark mark='d'/> One honest caveat: our simulator writes a to the x modulo N straight into the work register.
0ed80678f522.zh: 我们的模拟器分解15，取 a 等于7，用9个计数量子比特，也就是15的4位的两倍再加1：512个结果。<bookmark mark='a'/>逆傅里叶变换之后，全部概率落在四个尖峰上，每个四分之一，位于512除以4的倍数处，正如第七章所预言的。<bookmark mark='b'/>384除以512是四分之三，它的分母就是阶，4。<bookmark mark='c'/>结果为256的一次运行给出二分之一，因为 s 和 r 有公因子，而结果为0的一次运行什么也给不出。我们的20次运行中，有9次直接找到了4。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个诚实的说明：我们的模拟器把 a 的 x 次方模 N 直接写进了工作寄存器。

4dff440c791d.en: Twenty-one, with a equal to two, is less tidy: the order is six, which does not divide two thousand and forty-eight. <bookmark mark='a'/> So the peaks fall between outcomes, and probability leaks to the neighbours: about eleven per cent on the nearest, almost three on the next. <bookmark mark='b'/> Suppose a shot gives seventeen hundred and seven. Expand it over two thousand and forty-eight as a continued fraction, Euclid's algorithm in disguise, and stop before the denominator passes twenty-one: five sixths. <bookmark mark='c'/> The order is six. Two cubed is eight, and seven and nine share the factors seven and three with twenty-one. <bookmark mark='d'/> Why does it work? With two to the t at least N squared, the nearest outcome is so close to s over r that s over r must be a convergent. <bookmark mark='e'/> A shot giving two thirds or one half yields a divisor of six, and the least common multiple of two such divisors recovers it.
4dff440c791d.zh: 21，取 a 等于2，就没那么整齐了：阶是6，而6不整除2048。<bookmark mark='a'/>所以峰落在结果之间，概率泄漏到邻居上：最近的上面大约百分之11，再下一个上面将近百分之3。<bookmark mark='b'/>假设一次运行给出1707。把1707除以2048展开成连分数，这是伪装起来的欧几里得算法，在分母超过21之前停下：六分之五。<bookmark mark='c'/>阶是6。2的立方是8，而7和9与21分别共有因子7和3。<bookmark mark='d'/>为什么这样管用？只要2的 t 次方至少是 N 的平方，最近的结果就离 r 分之 s 足够近，以至于 r 分之 s 必定是一个渐近分数。<bookmark mark='e'/>给出三分之二或二分之一的运行，得到的是6的一个约数，而两个这样的约数的最小公倍数就能把它恢复出来。

69fb793149fc.en: <bookmark mark='a'/> The best known classical method, Part 30's number field sieve, takes time growing roughly like e to the cube root of the number of bits. Shor's algorithm needs about n cubed gates. On a logarithmic scale, one curve keeps climbing and the other barely rises. <bookmark mark='b'/> The sieve's record, RSA-250, eight hundred and twenty-nine bits, took about two thousand seven hundred core-years in 2020. <bookmark mark='c'/> Shor's method also finds discrete logarithms, so Diffie–Hellman and elliptic curves fall with RSA. <bookmark mark='d'/> A caution: early hardware runs that factored fifteen and twenty-one used circuits simplified with knowledge of the answer, as Smolin, Smith and Vargo pointed out in 2013.
69fb793149fc.zh: <bookmark mark='a'/>已知最好的经典方法，第30部分的数域筛法，用时大致按 e 的位数的立方根次方增长。Shor 算法大约需要 n 的立方个门。在对数坐标上，一条曲线不断攀升，另一条几乎不升。<bookmark mark='b'/>筛法的纪录是 RSA-250，829位，在2020年花了大约2700核年。<bookmark mark='c'/>Shor 的方法也能求离散对数，所以 Diffie–Hellman 和椭圆曲线会和 RSA 一起倒下。<bookmark mark='d'/>要小心一点：早期分解15和21的硬件实验，用的是借助答案的知识简化过的电路，Smolin、Smith 和 Vargo 在2013年指出了这一点。

b3d5b7cf8c6e.en: Chapter ten. Grover's search. How fast can a quantum computer find a needle?
b3d5b7cf8c6e.zh: 第十章：Grover 搜索。量子计算机能多快找到一根针？

e608a4dc2510.en: Grover's algorithm looks for one marked item w among N, using an oracle that flips the sign of w's amplitude. <bookmark mark='a'/> Everything happens in a plane: the marked state, and the even superposition of the unmarked ones. The starting state sits a small angle theta above the unmarked axis, with sine theta equal to one over root N. <bookmark mark='b'/> The oracle reflects the state in the unmarked axis. <bookmark mark='c'/> The diffusion step reflects it in the starting state. <bookmark mark='d'/> Two reflections make a rotation by twice the angle between the mirrors: two theta. After k rounds the angle is two k plus one, times theta. Here N is sixty-four, and six rounds carry the state just past vertical.
e608a4dc2510.zh: Grover 算法在 N 个项中寻找一个被标记的项 w，用的是一个把 w 的振幅符号翻转的谕示。<bookmark mark='a'/>一切都发生在一个平面上：被标记的状态，以及未标记项的均匀叠加。起始状态位于未标记轴上方一个小角 θ 处，正弦 θ 等于根号 N 分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>谕示把状态关于未标记轴作反射。<bookmark mark='c'/>扩散步骤把它关于起始状态作反射。<bookmark mark='d'/>两次反射合成一次旋转，转角是两面镜子夹角的两倍：2θ。k 轮之后，角度是2k 加1，乘以 θ。这里 N 是64，六轮把状态带到刚好越过竖直的位置。

d7a91cd36403.en: The same rounds, seen as the sixty-four amplitudes. <bookmark mark='a'/> At the start they are all equal, one eighth each. <bookmark mark='b'/> The oracle flips the marked amplitude below the axis. <bookmark mark='c'/> On amplitudes the diffusion step means: replace each one by twice the mean minus itself, an inversion about the mean. The mean has dropped a little, so the unmarked amplitudes shrink slightly, while the marked one, far below the mean, jumps far above it. <bookmark mark='d'/> Repeat. After six rounds the marked amplitude is nought point nine nine eight. <bookmark mark='e'/> Keep going and it falls again, as the unmarked amplitudes turn negative: the rotation has overshot.
d7a91cd36403.zh: 同样的这几轮，换成64个振幅来看。<bookmark mark='a'/>开始时它们都相等，各是八分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>谕示把被标记的振幅翻到轴的下方。<bookmark mark='c'/>对振幅来说，扩散步骤的意思是：把每一个替换成平均值的两倍减去它自己，也就是关于平均值的反演。平均值降了一点，所以未标记的振幅稍稍缩小，而被标记的那个，远在平均值之下，一下跳到远在它之上。<bookmark mark='d'/>重复。六轮之后，被标记的振幅是0.998。<bookmark mark='e'/>继续下去，它又会下降，因为未标记的振幅变成了负的：旋转转过头了。

5ce9c6bbc5b4.en: Our simulator's success probability against the number of rounds follows the formula exactly: sine squared of two k plus one, times theta. <bookmark mark='a'/> It peaks when the angle reaches a right angle, after about pi over four times root N rounds: for sixty-four items, six rounds, and success ninety-nine point seven per cent. <bookmark mark='b'/> Run longer and it falls: after twelve rounds it is almost zero, and then it climbs again. Unlike a classical search, more work can make the answer worse. <bookmark mark='c'/> As N grows, the rounds grow like root N, while a classical search in random order needs about N over two looks on average: for sixty-five thousand items, two hundred and one rounds against about thirty-two thousand looks.
5ce9c6bbc5b4.zh: 我们模拟器的成功概率随轮数的变化，与公式完全吻合：2k 加1乘以 θ 的正弦平方。<bookmark mark='a'/>当角度达到直角时，它达到峰值，大约在四分之 π 乘以根号 N 轮之后：对64个项，是六轮，成功率百分之99.7。<bookmark mark='b'/>运行更久，它就下降：12轮之后几乎为零，然后又爬升。和经典搜索不同，更多的工作可能让答案更差。<bookmark mark='c'/>随着 N 增大，轮数按根号 N 增长，而按随机顺序进行的经典搜索，平均需要查看大约 N 除以2次：对65000个项，是201轮，对大约32000次查看。

3ee73bc8c20a.en: Chapter eight promised another use for Grover's rotation. <bookmark mark='a'/> If M of the N items are marked, the same picture holds, with sine squared theta equal to M over N. Each round is a rotation by two theta in the plane. <bookmark mark='b'/> A rotation's eigenvalues are e to the plus and minus two i theta: its angle is written in its phases. <bookmark mark='c'/> So phase estimation applied to the Grover step reads theta, and N sine squared theta counts the solutions without finding them. This is quantum counting, from Brassard, Høyer and Tapp in 1998, and it also says how many rounds to run. <bookmark mark='d'/> Nothing requires the Hadamards. Replace them by any algorithm that succeeds with probability p, and about one over root p rounds replace one over p repetitions.
3ee73bc8c20a.zh: 第八章承诺过 Grover 旋转的另一个用处。<bookmark mark='a'/>如果 N 个项中有 M 个被标记，同样的图景依然成立，只是正弦平方 θ 等于 M 除以 N。每一轮都是平面上转过2θ 的一次旋转。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个旋转的特征值是 e 的正负2i θ 次方：它的角度写在它的相位里。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以对 Grover 步骤做相位估计，就能读出 θ，而 N 乘以正弦平方 θ，不必找到解就能数出解的个数。这就是量子计数，出自 Brassard、Høyer 和 Tapp 1998年的工作，它还能告诉我们该运行多少轮。<bookmark mark='d'/>没有什么要求必须用 Hadamard。把它们换成任何一个以概率 p 成功的算法，大约根号 p 分之一轮，就能取代 p 分之一次重复。

11d6f2b35b0b.en: Could a cleverer algorithm beat root N? No. <bookmark mark='a'/> Compare each run with a run whose oracle marks nothing. One query can push the two apart by at most twice the amplitude the algorithm puts on w at that moment. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add over all N choices of w. Those amplitudes square to one in total, so they sum to at most root N, and T queries move all the runs apart by at most two T root N in total. <bookmark mark='c'/> But to name w, every one of the N runs must end a fixed distance from the run that marks nothing. <bookmark mark='d'/> So T is at least a constant times root N, as Bennett, Bernstein, Brassard and Vazirani proved in 1997. <bookmark mark='e'/> Brute-force search over n-bit keys drops only from two to the n to two to the n over two: still exponential.
11d6f2b35b0b.zh: 更聪明的算法能胜过根号 N 吗？不能。<bookmark mark='a'/>把每次运行与一个什么都不标记的谕示的运行作比较。一次查询至多能把两者推开的距离，是算法在那一刻放在 w 上的振幅的两倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>对 w 的全部 N 种选择求和。这些振幅的平方总和为1，所以它们的和至多是根号 N，而 T 次查询总共至多能把所有运行推开2T 根号 N。<bookmark mark='c'/>但要说出 w，N 次运行中的每一次，最终都必须与什么都不标记的运行相距一个固定的距离。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以 T 至少是一个常数乘以根号 N，这是贝内特、Bernstein、Brassard 和 Vazirani 在1997年证明的。<bookmark mark='e'/>对 n 位密钥的暴力搜索，只从2的 n 次方降到2的二分之 n 次方：仍然是指数级的。

3b5fc4b10cfe.en: Chapter eleven. What quantum computers cannot do. Where does BQP sit among the classes?
3b5fc4b10cfe.zh: 第十一章：量子计算机做不到的事。BQP 在各个复杂性类中处于什么位置？

2f2c9e6382d0.en: What exactly can a quantum computer do efficiently? <bookmark mark='a'/> The class is BQP, defined by Bernstein and Vazirani in 1993. A problem is in it if, for inputs of n bits, a classical program can write down in polynomial time a circuit of polynomially many gates from chapter four's set, ending in the measurement of one qubit. <bookmark mark='b'/> On yes-instances it accepts with probability at least two thirds; on no-instances, at most one third. <bookmark mark='c'/> The thirds are arbitrary: run it k times and take the majority, and the error falls exponentially in k, as for Part 27's BPP. <bookmark mark='d'/> And BQP contains BPP: chapter one's Toffoli gates make any classical circuit reversible, and a Hadamard on a fresh qubit is a fair coin.
2f2c9e6382d0.zh: 量子计算机究竟能高效地做什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>这个类是 BQP，由 Bernstein 和 Vazirani 在1993年定义。一个问题属于它，如果对 n 位的输入，一个经典程序能在多项式时间内写出一个电路，它由第四章门集中的多项式个门组成，最后测量一个量子比特。<bookmark mark='b'/>在“是”实例上，它以至少三分之二的概率接受；在“否”实例上，至多三分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>这些三分之一是任意取的：运行 k 次取多数，错误就随 k 指数级下降，就像第27部分的 BPP 那样。<bookmark mark='d'/>而且 BQP 包含 BPP：第一章的托福利门能让任何经典电路变成可逆的，而对一个新的量子比特做 Hadamard，就是一枚公平的硬币。

63e8f70472a7.en: Where does BQP sit among the classical classes? <bookmark mark='a'/> It contains BPP, as we saw. <bookmark mark='b'/> For an upper bound, write the amplitude of an outcome as Feynman did: a sum over every path through the intermediate basis states, multiplying along each path and adding across paths, as in chapter five. <bookmark mark='c'/> With only Hadamard and Toffoli gates, which suffice for any quantum computation, every path weighs plus or minus the same small number. The amplitude is the count of positive paths minus the count of negative ones, scaled. <bookmark mark='d'/> A classical machine can add the paths one at a time, reusing its memory: exponential time, but polynomial space. And comparing the counts puts BQP inside PP, as Adleman, DeMarrais and Huang showed in 1997. <bookmark mark='e'/> None of these inclusions is known to be strict.
63e8f70472a7.zh: BQP 在经典的复杂性类中处于什么位置？<bookmark mark='a'/>如我们所见，它包含 BPP。<bookmark mark='b'/>至于上界，像 Feynman 那样写出一个结果的振幅：对穿过中间基态的每一条路径求和，沿每条路径相乘，在路径之间相加，就像第五章那样。<bookmark mark='c'/>只用 Hadamard 门和托福利门，它们就足以完成任何量子计算，这时每条路径的权重都是正负同一个小数。振幅就是正路径的条数减去负路径的条数，再乘以一个比例因子。<bookmark mark='d'/>经典机器可以一次加一条路径，重复利用它的内存：指数时间，但多项式空间。而比较这两个计数，就把 BQP 放进了 PP 之内，这是 Adleman、DeMarrais 和 Huang 在1997年证明的。<bookmark mark='e'/>这些包含关系，没有一个已知是严格的。

59aa8ef76e5a.en: Does BQP contain the NP-complete problems? Nobody knows, but the evidence says no. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is the picture most researchers believe, though none of it is proved. Factoring and discrete logarithms lie in BQP and in NP, and are not thought to be NP-complete. <bookmark mark='b'/> The NP-complete problems sit outside BQP. Brute force gains only a square root: sixty-five thousand assignments of sixteen variables still need two hundred and one Grover rounds. And relative to a random oracle, Bennett, Bernstein, Brassard and Vazirani showed that NP is not inside BQP. <bookmark mark='c'/> A fast quantum algorithm would have to exploit structure, as Shor's does. <bookmark mark='d'/> BQP may also reach outside NP: relative to an oracle, Raz and Tal showed in 2018 that it escapes the whole polynomial hierarchy.
59aa8ef76e5a.zh: BQP 包含 NP 完全问题吗？没有人知道，但证据说不包含。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是大多数研究者相信的图景，尽管其中没有一点被证明。因数分解和离散对数既在 BQP 中，也在 NP 中，而且人们不认为它们是 NP 完全的。<bookmark mark='b'/>NP 完全问题位于 BQP 之外。暴力搜索只能获得平方根的加速：16个变量的65000种赋值，仍然需要201轮 Grover 迭代。而且相对于一个随机谕示，贝内特、Bernstein、Brassard 和 Vazirani 证明了 NP 不包含于 BQP。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个快速的量子算法必须利用结构，就像 Shor 算法那样。<bookmark mark='d'/>BQP 还可能伸到 NP 之外：相对于一个谕示，Raz 和 Tal 在2018年证明了它逃出了整个多项式层级。

ff704b1b0657.en: If quantum computers are more powerful, an experiment should show it. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2011 Scott Aaronson and Alex Arkhipov, and independently Bremner, Jozsa and Shepherd, identified sampling tasks natural for quantum hardware and, under complexity assumptions, hard for classical machines: an efficient exact classical sampler would collapse the polynomial hierarchy. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2019 Google's team reported sampling from random circuits on fifty-three qubits in about two hundred seconds, and estimated ten thousand years for a supercomputer. <bookmark mark='c'/> IBM replied that, with better use of disk storage, a supercomputer would need about two and a half days. <bookmark mark='d'/> In 2020 a team in China reported a photonic version. <bookmark mark='e'/> By 2022, tensor-network methods had simulated the 2019 task. The contest goes on, and the extended Church–Turing thesis is now being tested in the laboratory.
ff704b1b0657.zh: 如果量子计算机更强大，实验就应该能表明这一点。<bookmark mark='a'/>2011年，Scott Aaronson 和 Alex Arkhipov，以及独立地，Bremner、Jozsa 和 Shepherd，找到了一些采样任务：它们对量子硬件来说很自然，而在复杂性假设之下，对经典机器很难：一个高效而精确的经典采样器，会让多项式层级坍塌。<bookmark mark='b'/>2019年，Google 的团队报告，在53个量子比特上从随机电路中采样，用了大约200秒，并估计一台超级计算机要用1万年。<bookmark mark='c'/>IBM 回应说，更好地利用磁盘存储，一台超级计算机大约只需要两天半。<bookmark mark='d'/>2020年，中国的一个团队报告了一个光子版本。<bookmark mark='e'/>到2022年，张量网络方法已经模拟出了2019年的那个任务。较量还在继续，而扩展的丘奇–图灵论题，如今正在实验室里接受检验。

48564d471ec9.en: Two limits bind every quantum algorithm. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first is the polynomial method of Beals, Buhrman, Cleve, Mosca and de Wolf, from 1998. Each query multiplies amplitudes by something linear in one input bit, so after T queries every amplitude is a polynomial of degree at most T in the input bits, <bookmark mark='b'/> and the acceptance probability has degree at most two T. <bookmark mark='c'/> Parity flips with every bit, so approximating it needs degree N, and computing the parity of N bits needs N over two queries. Deutsch's trick from chapter five achieves exactly that. <bookmark mark='d'/> Without a promise, quantum queries save at most a polynomial factor. Exponential speedups, like Simon's and Shor's, need structure. <bookmark mark='e'/> The second is Holevo's bound: n qubits carry at most n classical bits.
48564d471ec9.zh: 有两个限制约束着每一个量子算法。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一个是 Beals、Buhrman、Cleve、Mosca 和 de Wolf 在1998年提出的多项式方法。每次查询把振幅乘以某个关于一个输入位的线性式，所以 T 次查询之后，每个振幅都是输入位的一个次数至多为 T 的多项式，<bookmark mark='b'/>而接受概率的次数至多是2T。<bookmark mark='c'/>奇偶性随每一位翻转，所以逼近它需要次数为 N 的多项式，而计算 N 位的奇偶性需要 N 除以2次查询。第五章的 Deutsch 技巧恰好做到了这一点。<bookmark mark='d'/>没有承诺时，量子查询至多节省一个多项式因子。指数级的加速，比如 Simon 和 Shor 的那些，需要结构。<bookmark mark='e'/>第二个是 Holevo 界：n 个量子比特至多携带 n 位经典信息。

3cb183e5351f.en: Chapter twelve. Quantum error correction. How do we protect a state we may neither copy nor look at?
3cb183e5351f.zh: 第十二章：量子纠错。一个既不能复制、也不能查看的状态，我们怎样保护它？

fa171f8b66ac.en: Part 28 protected bits by copying them and reading the copies. For qubits all three ideas seemed to fail, and some leading physicists doubted that quantum computers could be made reliable. <bookmark mark='a'/> First, chapter three's no-cloning theorem forbids copies. <bookmark mark='b'/> Second, reading a qubit destroys it: measure a superposition, and you are left with zero or one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Third, errors are continuous: a qubit can drift by any small angle. <bookmark mark='d'/> In 1995 Peter Shor found a way round all three, and Andrew Steane another in 1996: spread the state by entanglement, and measure only parities, which reveal the error but nothing about the state.
fa171f8b66ac.zh: 第28部分保护位的办法，是复制它们并读取这些副本。对量子比特，这三个想法看起来都行不通，一些顶尖的物理学家曾怀疑量子计算机能否做得可靠。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一，第三章的不可克隆定理禁止复制。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二，读取一个量子比特会毁掉它：测量一个叠加态，你只剩下零或一。<bookmark mark='c'/>第三，错误是连续的：一个量子比特可以漂移任意小的角度。<bookmark mark='d'/>1995年，Peter Shor 找到了绕过这三点的办法，Andrew Steane 在1996年找到了另一种：用纠缠把状态铺开，只测量奇偶性，它们揭示错误，却不透露关于状态的任何信息。

9843248d7db1.en: The simplest code protects against bit flips. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two CNOTs spread one qubit over three, as one entangled state, not three copies. <bookmark mark='b'/> Suppose the middle qubit flips. <bookmark mark='c'/> Measure two parities, using extra qubits: does the first agree with the second, and the second with the third? Both terms give the same answers, so we learn where the error is and nothing about the amplitudes. <bookmark mark='d'/> Each single flip lights a different pattern, the syndrome, as with Part 28's Hamming code. Flip the culprit back, and our simulator recovers the original amplitudes in all four cases.
9843248d7db1.zh: 最简单的码防的是位翻转。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个 CNOT 把一个量子比特铺开到三个上，成为一个纠缠态，而不是三个副本。<bookmark mark='b'/>假设中间的量子比特翻转了。<bookmark mark='c'/>借助额外的量子比特，测量两个奇偶性：第一个和第二个是否一致，第二个和第三个是否一致？两项给出相同的答案，所以我们得知错误在哪里，而对振幅一无所知。<bookmark mark='d'/>每一种单个翻转点亮一种不同的模式，也就是伴随式，就像第28部分的汉明码那样。把出错的那个翻回来，我们的模拟器在全部四种情况下都恢复了原来的振幅。

2ff42089a57c.en: The third obstacle, continuous error, dissolves when the syndrome is measured. <bookmark mark='a'/> A small unwanted rotation by epsilon is a combination of doing nothing and a full bit flip. <bookmark mark='b'/> Applied to the encoded state, it makes a superposition of no error and one whole flip. <bookmark mark='c'/> Measuring the syndrome forces a choice: with probability cosine squared epsilon, no error; with sine squared epsilon, a whole flip, which we know how to undo. <bookmark mark='d'/> And any error on one qubit is a combination of four: nothing, a bit flip, a phase flip, or both. Correct bit flips and phase flips, and everything else is corrected.
2ff42089a57c.zh: 第三个障碍，连续的错误，在测量伴随式时就消解了。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个小小的、不想要的转角为 ε 的旋转，是什么都不做与一次完整位翻转的组合。<bookmark mark='b'/>作用在编码后的状态上，它产生无错误与一次完整翻转的叠加。<bookmark mark='c'/>测量伴随式会迫使它作出选择：以余弦平方 ε 的概率，没有错误；以正弦平方 ε 的概率，一次完整的翻转，而我们知道怎样撤销它。<bookmark mark='d'/>而一个量子比特上的任何错误，都是四种的组合：什么都没有、位翻转、相位翻转，或者两者都有。纠正了位翻转和相位翻转，其他一切也就都纠正了。

445cfa1dbb09.en: Qubits suffer a second kind of error: a phase flip, which turns plus into minus. <bookmark mark='a'/> In the Hadamard basis a phase flip is a bit flip, so the same code, turned sideways, catches it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Shor nested the two: three blocks against phase flips, and each block three qubits against bit flips, nine in all. <bookmark mark='c'/> A phase flip anywhere in a block changes that block's sign, and the checks comparing neighbouring blocks light up. <bookmark mark='d'/> Every check is a product of Pauli operators that leaves each codeword alone. Daniel Gottesman's stabilizer formalism of 1997 describes whole families of codes this way: here eight checks on nine qubits leave one logical qubit.
445cfa1dbb09.zh: 量子比特还会遭受第二种错误：相位翻转，它把加态变成减态。<bookmark mark='a'/>在 Hadamard 基下，相位翻转就是位翻转，所以同一个码转个方向，就能抓住它。<bookmark mark='b'/>Shor 把两者嵌套起来：三个块防相位翻转，每个块三个量子比特防位翻转，一共九个。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个块中任何地方的相位翻转，都会改变那个块的符号，比较相邻块的校验就会亮起来。<bookmark mark='d'/>每个校验都是 Pauli 算符的一个乘积，它让每个码字保持不变。Daniel Gottesman 1997年的稳定子形式体系，就用这种方式描述整族的码：这里九个量子比特上的八个校验，留下一个逻辑量子比特。

beaad6c50b24.en: The leading design today is the surface code, from Alexei Kitaev's toric code of 1997, developed by Dennis, Kitaev, Landahl and Preskill, and by Fowler and colleagues in 2012. <bookmark mark='a'/> Data qubits sit on the corners of a grid. Each face measures the parity of its corners: blue faces catch bit flips, purple faces phase flips, and every check touches only near neighbours. <bookmark mark='b'/> A bit flip lights the blue faces beside it. <bookmark mark='c'/> A chain of flips lights only its two ends, and a decoder pairs the lit faces by the shortest chains that explain them. <bookmark mark='d'/> Only a chain right across the lattice goes unseen: at distance five that takes five errors, and any two are corrected.
beaad6c50b24.zh: 今天领先的设计是表面码，它来自 Alexei Kitaev 1997年的环面码，由 Dennis、Kitaev、Landahl 和 Preskill，以及 Fowler 和同事们在2012年发展起来。<bookmark mark='a'/>数据量子比特位于网格的角点上。每个面测量它各个角的奇偶性：蓝色的面抓位翻转，紫色的面抓相位翻转，而每个校验只涉及近邻。<bookmark mark='b'/>一次位翻转点亮它旁边的蓝色面。<bookmark mark='c'/>一串翻转只点亮它的两端，而解码器用能解释它们的最短链，把点亮的面配成对。<bookmark mark='d'/>只有一条横穿整个格子的链才不会被看见：在距离为5时，这需要5个错误，而任意两个错误都能被纠正。

3adb2f21f3f6.en: Take the simplest case: the repetition code against independent bit flips. <bookmark mark='a'/> With distance d and a majority vote, the code fails only if more than half the bits flip. <bookmark mark='b'/> For small p the first failing term dominates, so the logical error falls like p to the power d plus one over two. <bookmark mark='c'/> Below the threshold, here one half, a bigger code is better: at one per cent, each step in distance divides the error by about thirty. Above it, bigger is worse. <bookmark mark='d'/> Real codes under real noise have thresholds near one per cent. In 2024 Google's team grew a surface code from distance three to five to seven, and each step roughly halved the logical error: clearly below threshold, in hardware.
3adb2f21f3f6.zh: 取最简单的情形：针对独立位翻转的重复码。<bookmark mark='a'/>距离为 d、用多数表决时，只有超过一半的位翻转，这个码才会失败。<bookmark mark='b'/>对小的 p，第一个失败项占主导，所以逻辑错误率像 p 的 d 加1再除以2次方那样下降。<bookmark mark='c'/>在阈值以下，这里是二分之一，码越大越好：在百分之1时，距离每增加一级，错误大约除以30。在阈值以上，越大越差。<bookmark mark='d'/>真实噪声下的真实码，阈值接近百分之1。2024年，Google 的团队把一个表面码从距离3增大到5再到7，每一步大致把逻辑错误减半：在硬件上，明确地处于阈值之下。

45ecc244ffd0.en: Chapter thirteen, the frontier. What will quantum computers actually change, and when?
45ecc244ffd0.zh: 第十三章：前沿。量子计算机究竟会改变什么？又会在什么时候？

6af0a3309905.en: Quantum mechanics also protects secrets. <bookmark mark='a'/> In Bennett and Brassard's protocol of 1984, Alice sends random bits, each encoded in one of two bases chosen at random. Bob measures each in a random basis, and afterwards they compare bases in public and keep only the positions where they agreed. <bookmark mark='b'/> With nobody listening, our simulation's kept bits agree perfectly. <bookmark mark='c'/> An eavesdropper must measure to learn anything, and measuring in the wrong basis disturbs the state: a quarter of the kept bits come out wrong, and Alice and Bob notice. <bookmark mark='d'/> The more urgent defence needs no quantum hardware at all. In 2024 the United States standards body NIST published post-quantum algorithms that replace RSA and elliptic curves with lattice and hash-based problems not known to fall to Shor's algorithm, and the migration is under way, because data recorded today could be decrypted later.
6af0a3309905.zh: 量子力学也能保护秘密。<bookmark mark='a'/>在贝内特和 Brassard 1984年的协议里，Alice 发送随机的位，每一位都编码在随机选定的两组基之一中。Bob 用随机的基测量每一位，之后他们公开比较所用的基，只保留两人一致的那些位置。<bookmark mark='b'/>没有人偷听时，我们模拟中保留下来的位完全一致。<bookmark mark='c'/>窃听者要了解任何东西就必须测量，而用错误的基测量会扰动状态：保留下来的位中有四分之一会出错，Alice 和 Bob 就会察觉。<bookmark mark='d'/>更紧迫的防御根本不需要量子硬件。2024年，美国标准机构 NIST 发布了后量子算法，用格和基于哈希的问题取代 RSA 和椭圆曲线，这些问题还不知道会被 Shor 算法攻破；迁移正在进行，因为今天记录下来的数据，以后可能被解密。

7680666974bc.en: How far away is a machine that breaks today's cryptography? <bookmark mark='a'/> Resource estimates have fallen fast. In 2019 Craig Gidney and Martin Ekerå estimated that factoring a 2048-bit RSA key would take about twenty million noisy qubits for about eight hours. In 2025 Gidney brought that under a million qubits, in under a week. <bookmark mark='b'/> Both assume physical error rates of about one in a thousand, and the surface code of chapter twelve; today's largest machines have hundreds to about a thousand physical qubits. <bookmark mark='c'/> The decisive step is error correction that improves as the code grows, and in 2024 Google's team showed it: each step up in distance roughly halved the logical error rate. Our repetition code does far better on paper, but it only corrects bit flips, while a real code must also catch phase errors.
7680666974bc.zh: 一台能攻破今天密码学的机器还有多远？<bookmark mark='a'/>资源估计下降得很快。2019年，Craig Gidney 和 Martin Ekerå 估计，分解一个2048位的 RSA 密钥，大约需要2000万个带噪量子比特，运行大约8小时。2025年，Gidney 把它降到了100万个量子比特以下，用时不到一周。<bookmark mark='b'/>两者都假设物理错误率大约是千分之一，并使用第十二章的表面码；今天最大的机器有几百到大约一千个物理量子比特。<bookmark mark='c'/>决定性的一步，是随着码变大而改进的纠错，而在2024年，Google 的团队展示了它：距离每增加一级，逻辑错误率大致减半。我们的重复码在纸面上表现得好得多，但它只纠正位翻转，而一个真实的码还必须抓住相位错误。

4b9a2238d4fc.en: What are they likely to be good for? <bookmark mark='a'/> First, Feynman's own problem: simulating molecules and materials whose electrons are too entangled for classical methods, where a quantum computer simply is the right kind of machine. <bookmark mark='b'/> Second, cryptanalysis, which is why the migration to new cryptography has already begun. <bookmark mark='c'/> Elsewhere the case is weaker.
